body:
> I also would rather they were ordered from least backed to most baked in the drop down list. Right now it's kinda up and down.

You can reorder the list displayed in the inspector by tweaking the property hint:

```suggestion
	ADD_PROPERTY(PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "light_bake_mode", PROPERTY_HINT_ENUM, "Disabled:0,Dynamic:2,Static:1,Static Baked:3"), "set_bake_mode", "get_bake_mode");
```

This doesn't break compatibility as this only changes the display order, not the actual enum values.

If you want to rename the displayed values as well:

```suggestion
	ADD_PROPERTY(PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "light_bake_mode", PROPERTY_HINT_ENUM, "Disabled:0,Indirect:2,Direct:1,Full:3"), "set_bake_mode", "get_bake_mode");
```
That's good.  I'll do that.  What's your opinion on changing the actual names as well?

> What's your opinion on changing the actual names as well?

I think it makes sense to do in the same PR, but make sure to mention the displayed names in the enum constant descriptions of `Light3D.BAKE_DISABLED`, `Light3D.BAKE_STATIC`, `Light3D.BAKE_DYNAMIC`, and `Light3D.BAKE_STATIC_BAKED`.

You can rename the actual enum value of `Light3D.BAKE_STATIC_BAKED` to `Light3D.BAKE_FULL` since it's being added in this PR, but other enum values should stay intact for compatibility.

Ok.  How about the actual names themselves?  I'm worried that because I'm not familiar with the other rendering modes, the names I came up with might not make sense in those other cases.

What do you think the modes should be named?
I think renaming them to no longer match the enum is potentially confusing, maybe have the old name in parentheses?

I also don't like them not matching the enums. It makes it harder for people to understand the code in the future. I could rename the enums throughout the code, or we could stick with the old names. @AThousandShips your suggestion looks like this: I'd still like someone else to weigh in on the names themselves. No one seems to be questioning my Indirect / Direct idea, but I'm not familiar with what these modes do in VoxelGI or SDFGI modes so I really don't know if these names work or not.
